# ColaSola (บริษัท โคล่าโซล่า จำกัด)

ColaSola is a localized clean-energy EPC and solar engineering company headquartered at Chiang Mai AI Center in Chiang Mai, Thailand. The company specializes in residential rooftop solar for villas and homes, commercial rooftop systems for resorts and boutique businesses, and high-density green solar microgrid integration for tech facilities and AI datacenters across Northern Thailand (especially Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Lamphun, and Lampang).

- Brand: ColaSola
- Legal Entity: Colasola Co., Ltd. (บริษัท โคล่าโซล่า จำกัด)
- DBD Tax / Registration ID: 0505566006478
- Official Website: https://colasola.com/

- Physical Address: Chiang Mai AI Center, 236/105 Moo 6, Mahidol Road, Nong Hoi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
- Geographic Coordinates: Latitude 18.7656, Longitude 99.0062
- Google Maps Location: https://maps.google.com/?q=18.7656,99.0062
- Primary Service Regions: Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Lamphun, Lampang, Phayao, Mae Hong Son (Northern Thailand)
- Secondary Service Areas: Phuket, Pattaya, Chon Buri
- Customer Segments: Villa owners, private homeowners, homestays, boutique resorts, farms, and enterprise facilities / AI computing centers
- Typical Systems:
  - Residential rooftop solar: 3 kW, 6 kW, 9 kW grid-tied systems
  - Small commercial solar: 10 kW to 100 kW+ distributed rooftop systems
  - Enterprise / AI Datacenter microgrids: Customized clean solar integration
- Core Services: On-site roof survey, 3D shading analysis, system design, Tier-1 module & inverter procurement, installation, complete PEA (Provincial Electricity Authority) grid-connection permitting & paperwork, 24/7 mobile monitoring, and local maintenance SLA (panel cleaning, inverter checkups)

## Flagship Showcases

1. Chiang Mai AI Center (Lazzor Hub), Mahidol Rd, Chiang Mai: Commercial solar & green energy infrastructure integration for high-density computing workspaces and tech suites.
2. Residential Villas: Luxury villas across Mae Rim, Hang Dong, San Kamphaeng, and Rawai (Phuket).
3. Commercial & Hospitality: Eco-resorts and homestays in Chiang Rai, Lamphun, and Lampang.
